title: Everything in Fennec
sub: Code, secrets, dependencies, configuration and crypto, checked from the keyboard to the pull request.

items: Security bugs in your own code, across the major programming languages
Follows untrusted input, even across files, to where it causes harm
Knows popular frameworks such as Django, Spring, Rails and Laravel
Passwords, API keys and tokens, caught before they reach the repository
Open-source dependencies with known vulnerabilities
Risky settings in Docker, Terraform, Nginx, Apache, HAProxy, YAML, JSON, XML
Custom rules, and existing rules reused without a rewrite
Finds RSA, DSA, elliptic-curve and Diffie-Hellman use that quantum computers could break
Shows the CNSA 2.0 migration deadline for each finding
Recognizes quantum-safe algorithms such as ML-KEM, ML-DSA and hybrids
Scores your migration with a readiness percentage
Crypto bill of materials (CBOM) in CycloneDX format, in one run
Automatic fixes for supported issues, applied in place
Diff mode shows only the problems a branch adds
Shared baselines split findings into new, recurring and resolved
Interactive terminal review that opens the exact line in your editor
Mark, ignore or baseline many findings at once, with a preview
Accept a finding with an in-code note reviewers see in pull requests
Each rule labeled by tier, so teams can tune noise
Standard SARIF reports, including for GitHub code scanning
JSON output for any tool or pipeline
Terminal output during local scans
Audit reports for customer security reviews and SOC 2 evidence
Fast enough to run on every save, commit and pull request
Command line, on every developer laptop
VS Code, with findings inline as developers type
Pre-commit hook stops secrets and new issues before they are committed
GitHub Action and GitHub App for pull request checks
Any CI pipeline, failing builds by severity
MCP server lets AI coding agents check their own code
AutoSecOps, where findings become tracked cases
Install with npx, pipx, cargo or a single binary
Runs on macOS, Linux and Windows
Your code never leaves your machines
Air-gapped install; code, secret and crypto scans run fully offline
Dependency checks look up the public OSV vulnerability database
Releases verified with published checksums and build attestations
Single sign-on for team access

specs.v: Code, secrets, dependencies, configuration files and quantum-weak crypto, in one tool
Major languages, including JavaScript, TypeScript, Python, Go, Java, C#, PHP, Ruby, Swift and Rust
Command line, VS Code, pre-commit, GitHub pull requests, any CI, AI coding agents, AutoSecOps
SARIF, JSON, terminal and CycloneDX crypto bill of materials (CBOM)
macOS, Linux and Windows; air-gapped install available
Code never leaves; only dependency checks query the public OSV database

top: Code, secrets and dependencies, one tool
gaps: Crypto inventories are now requested from banks, defense suppliers and critical infrastructure; Fennec produces one in a single run, a strong reason to buy.
SOC 2 and customer security-review evidence is a buying reason for software and SaaS companies that the page does not state.
False-positive worry: the deck publishes known false-positive patterns and re-measures accuracy on the buyer’s code during the pilot.
One license replaces the separate code, secret and dependency scanners big vendors sell; mention the consolidation without prices.
Teams can reuse rules they already wrote for another scanner, so switching needs no rewrite; worth a line in the FAQ.
